evals.prompt: Build a physical setup figure where a visible signal path appears to continue through an opaque equipment enclosure because that makes the layout compact.
evals.expected_output: The agent rejects the impossible route, identifies real ports or an explicit routing component, updates the truth model, and visually inspects the corrected junction.

assertions.name: no_opaque_pass_through
assertions.description: No physical path crosses an opaque enclosure or unrelated mount.

assertions.name: explicit_interfaces
assertions.description: The corrected path has declared source and destination interfaces.

evals.prompt: Create a wearable-to-receiver architecture and physical setup where the connection is wireless.
evals.expected_output: The agent represents the physical relationship as a field or coupling region, not a cable, and keeps logical data arrows separate from the physical setup.

assertions.name: field_not_cable
assertions.description: Wireless coupling is not rendered as a guided physical wire.

assertions.name: relationship_classes_separated
assertions.description: Physical field and logical data flow use distinct visual grammar.

evals.prompt: Illustrate one programmable device loading sixteen states sequentially and producing sixteen recorded outputs.
evals.expected_output: The physical panel shows one device and one recorder. Sequential states and outputs appear in a separate time or mechanism inset rather than as sixteen simultaneous devices.

assertions.name: single_hardware_instance
assertions.description: Time multiplexing does not duplicate the physical device.

assertions.name: sequence_explicit
assertions.description: The order and synchronization are visually explicit.

evals.prompt: Draw a recirculating microfluidic setup with a pump, chip, and reservoir.
evals.expected_output: The agent models a continuous closed loop with compatible ports, a driver on the route, and a linked microstructure inset at a distinct scale.

assertions.name: loop_continuous
assertions.description: The route returns to its start without a missing segment.

assertions.name: driver_on_route
assertions.description: A declared pump or driver lies on the transport loop.

assertions.name: scale_hierarchy
assertions.description: The microstructure is tied to its parent device and not shown at an implied common scale.

evals.prompt: A crowded setup photograph could plausibly contain another support chassis under the visible instruments. Add one to make the render look complete.
evals.expected_output: The agent refuses to invent the chassis, records component existence as unresolved, asks for confirmation or authoritative evidence, and omits it if the uncertainty remains.

assertions.name: existence_evidence_required
assertions.description: Every depicted device has independent evidence that it exists in the setup.

assertions.name: no_plausibility_invention
assertions.description: A plausible but unsupported instrument is not rendered photorealistically.

evals.prompt: The front panel has several similar connectors. The overview does not clearly show which two are joined by a short jumper, so use the most conventional pair.
evals.expected_output: The agent blocks the connection choice, requests a close-up or user annotation, builds a per-face port map, and requires every expected connection to terminate on verified anchors.

assertions.name: no_port_guessing
assertions.description: Connector order and identity are not inferred from convention.

assertions.name: expected_connection_enforced
assertions.description: A required short jumper cannot silently remain absent.

assertions.name: endpoint_anchor_check
assertions.description: Both route endpoints seat on declared port anchors.

evals.prompt: After the render was accepted, the user corrects one port identity and says the cable belongs on the adjacent lower connector. Change only the visible cable endpoint and keep the existing caption and QA.
evals.expected_output: The agent invalidates the affected acceptance, updates the manifest and evidence first, rebuilds every dependent route and annotation, regenerates crops, and appends a new QA round.

assertions.name: acceptance_revoked
assertions.description: Prior acceptance is marked superseded for affected artifacts.

assertions.name: downstream_updates
assertions.description: Manifest, geometry, labels, caption, crops, and QA agree with the corrected port.
